items.title: A Sonic Snapshot by Euan Fryer of Athens of the North
items.summary: The man behind the Edinburgh soul reissue label shoots a week of his own recording sessions on film, and leaves a playlist.

_homepage.note: Fryer takes the Lomo MC-A through a band session at Luke Oldfield's studio in Danham and then a week of overdubs at Athens of the North's own room in Edinburgh — the unglamorous middle of making a record, photographed rather than written about. It sits directly alongside the Athens of the North label profile in today's edition and the MC-A review 35mmc already gave this feed, and it is the rare piece genuinely about both shelves at once.

items.title: Critical Care Evidence Updates — October 2026
items.summary: The month's critical care literature compressed into appraised summaries, including the VANISH hydrocortisone post hoc.

_homepage.note: The feed already carries the August and September editions, and this is the one that picks apart proenkephalin A as a marker of who actually benefits from hydrocortisone in septic shock — heterogeneity of treatment effect, not another yes-or-no steroid answer. The format is the value: enough appraisal to know whether a paper is worth chasing to full text before a shift, which is the realistic unit of reading at registrar level.
